frequency_question: How often do central banks that establish a countercyclical capital buffer framework subsequently raise it above zero when economic conditions warrant, without technical wording failures?
membership_rule: Includes any G20 central bank or regulatory authority with an established CCyB framework between 2010 and 2026. Excludes jurisdictions without an active framework or where changes are purely administrative.
provenance_note: 5 cases named, 15 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (3.0x)
coverage_note: 5 major named precedents covering diverse regulatory outcomes among advanced economies with active frameworks.
known_gaps: Emerging market implementations where macroprudential policy operates through different institutional channels.
skeleton: Total G20/advanced economy jurisdictions with active CCyB frameworks over the period, categorized by whether the buffer was raised above 0% during economic cycles.
multiplier: Jurisdictions with framework (approx 30) times activation frequency per decade.
validity_reason: Macroprudential governance frameworks and regulatory response patterns evolve slowly over multi-year economic cycles.
